decisions.rationale: Charizard-Y and Venusaur give immediate fast Sun offense capable of overwhelming Trick Room setters or sleeping key targets with Chlorophyll speed. Backing them with Garganacl and Goodra-Hisui provides maximum bulk, Wide Guard utility, and strong matchups against Gardevoir, Kingambit, and Hatterene if Trick Room goes up.
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1. Revealed opponent sets: Gardevoir-Mega (Modest, Hyper Voice, Psychic, Trick Room), Farigiraf (Quiet, Mental Herb, Armor Tail, Trick Room, Psychic), Kingambit (Brave, BlackGlasses, Supreme Overlord). Foe favors dual Trick Room setups. Garganacl's Body Press, Wide Guard, and Salt Cure combined with Charizard-Y Sun offense effectively dismantles their slow Trick Room core.

decisions.rationale: TR mode with dual setters. Lead Gardevoir+Farigiraf: Farigiraf sets TR (Mental Herb blocks Taunt, Armor Tail blocks priority), Gardevoir Megas and attacks. Vs Wide Guard leads, use Psychic on the WG user; otherwise Pixilate Hyper Voice spread. Hatterene back provides backup TR, Magic Bounce vs Yawn/Sleep Powder, and LO Psychic pressure. Kingambit cleans late with BlackGlasses Kowtow Cleave under TR and Sucker Punch outside it.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 TR mode: Gardevoir-Mega Psychic OHKO threat on Venusaur (2x). Pixilate Hyper Voice neutral on Swampert/Garganacl. Hatterene LO Psychic 46-85% on Garganacl. Kingambit Kowtow Cleave 42-75% on Goodra-H. Opponent double Wide Guard (Swampert, Garganacl) counters spread; answer with single-target Psychic/Kowtow Cleave. Magic Bounce reflects Yawn/Sleep Powder/Will-O-Wisp. Armor Tail neutralizes any opposing priority.

decisions.rationale: Charizard Mega Evolves into Mega Charizard Y to activate Sun, doubling Venusaur's Speed via Chlorophyll and boosting Heat Wave. Heat Wave + Sludge Bomb double-targets Gardevoir for a guaranteed KO (109.2% min combined) before Gardevoir can act or set Trick Room, while also dealing 34.8-64.6% spread damage to Farigiraf.
decisions.notebook: Series tied 1-1. Revealed foe sets: Gardevoir-Mega (Modest, Hyper Voice, Psychic, TR), Farigiraf (Quiet, Mental Herb, Armor Tail, TR, Psychic), Kingambit (Brave, BlackGlasses, Supreme Overlord). Opponent relies on dual TR leads. Charizard Y Sun + Venusaur outspeeds both foes; Garganacl (Wide Guard, Salt Cure, Body Press) is our key pivot under TR.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gardevoir)
decisions.rationale: Gardevoir Protect+Mega Evolve avoids the guaranteed OHKO from Venusaur Sludge Bomb (148-275%) and sheds detrimental Solar Power for Pixilate. Farigiraf sets Trick Room at -7 priority after absorbing hits; it risks a double-target KO (Heat Wave 82-140% + Sludge Bomb 60-110%) but Mental Herb blocks Taunt and Armor Tail stops priority interference. If Farigiraf falls, Hatterene replaces it with backup TR. Mega Evolving now maximizes next-turn power under TR.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 TR mode: Gardevoir-Mega Psychic OHKO threat on Venusaur (2x). Pixilate Hyper Voice neutral on Swampert/Garganacl. Hatterene LO Psychic 46-85% on Garganacl. Kingambit Kowtow Cleave 42-75% on Goodra-H. Opponent double Wide Guard (Swampert, Garganacl) counters spread; answer with single-target Psychic/Kowtow Cleave. Magic Bounce reflects Yawn/Sleep Powder/Will-O-Wisp. Armor Tail neutralizes any opposing priority. Venusaur Sludge Bomb OHKOs Gardevoir; always respect it. Charizard-Y Drought enables Chlorophyll Venusaur (200-264 speed).

decisions.rationale: Kingambit immune to Venusaur's Sludge Bomb, forcing it to either target Gardevoir (survives 33-59%) or use weaker Earth Power. Hatterene takes 54-183% from Sludge Bomb + 35-114% from Heat Wave and likely faints before moving. Kingambit faces only Heat Wave (63-201%) and possible Earth Power (32-107%), giving better survival odds. Supreme Overlord already at 1.1x boost.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 TR mode: Gardevoir-Mega survives Venusaur LO Sludge Bomb (33-59%). Kingambit immune to Poison, weak to Fire/Ground. Hatterene has Magic Bounce for status reflection. Venusaur outspeeds all (200-264 Chlorophyll). Charizard-Y Drought enables Chlorophyll. Opponent double Wide Guard (Swampert, Garganacl) counters spread; answer with single-target Psychic/Kowtow Cleave. Magic Bounce reflects Yawn/Sleep Powder/Will-O-Wisp. Armor Tail neutralizes opposing priority (now gone).

decisions.rationale: Venusaur (264 Effective Speed under Sun) and Mega Charizard Y (167 Speed) both outspeed Gardevoir-Mega (120-152 Speed). Sludge Bomb (69.1-119.6%) plus Sun-boosted Heat Wave (38.9-67.8%) into Gardevoir-Mega deals at least 108% combined damage, guaranteeing a KO before Gardevoir can set Trick Room. Heat Wave simultaneously chunk/KO's Kingambit (90.8-162.9%). Sucker Punch cannot KO either of our Pokémon.
decisions.notebook: G3T1: Gardevoir Mega Evolved and used Protect; Farigiraf KOed by Charizard Heat Wave crit. G3T2: Outspeed Gardevoir before TR with Sludge Bomb + Heat Wave.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Kingambit)
decisions.rationale: Trick Room + Protect Kingambit. Venusaur outspeeds and likely Sludge Bombs Gardevoir (40-59%); Charizard's Overheat into Kingambit is blocked. TR reverses speed: next turn Kingambit (63) moves first under TR, can Kowtow Cleave Venusaur before it attacks again. Preserves Kingambit as win condition. Sleep Powder risk exists but opponent likely prefers guaranteed Sludge Bomb damage.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 TR mode: Gardevoir-Mega survives Venusaur LO Sludge Bomb (40-59%). Kingambit immune to Poison, weak to Fire/Ground. Hatterene has Magic Bounce for status reflection. Venusaur outspeeds all (200-264 Chlorophyll). Charizard-Y Drought enables Chlorophyll. Opponent double Wide Guard (Swampert, Garganacl) counters spread; answer with single-target Psychic/Kowtow Cleave. Magic Bounce reflects Yawn/Sleep Powder/Will-O-Wisp. Under TR, Kingambit (63) moves before Venusaur (100-132) and Charizard (132-167). Gardevoir at 128 may or may not outspeed Venusaur under TR depending on Venusaur's exact Speed.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Venusaur (264 Speed in Sun) and Charizard (167 Speed) both outspeed Hatterene (44-72) and Kingambit (63-91). Sludge Bomb (Life Orb) + Heat Wave double into Hatterene deals 138.8%-253.8%, guaranteeing a KO before Trick Room can be used. Heat Wave also hits Kingambit for 90.8%-162.9% super-effective damage in Sun, with a high chance to double KO and win immediately. If Kingambit survives, Venusaur outspeeds next turn in Sun to finish it with Earth Power.
decisions.notebook: G3T1: Gardevoir Mega Evolved and used Protect; Farigiraf KOed by Charizard Heat Wave crit. G3T2: Outspeed Gardevoir before TR with Sludge Bomb + Heat Wave. G3T3: Double into Hatterene with Sludge Bomb + Heat Wave to prevent TR and clear board.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Kingambit)
decisions.rationale: Only line with a win path: if foe predicts Hatterene Protect and Venusaur Earth Powers Kingambit instead, Sucker Punch chips Venusaur 39–72%, Kingambit falls to Zard, but TR goes up with full HP Hatterene vs damaged Venusaur + Zard. Under TR Hatterene outspeeds both and Psychic KOs Venusaur. If foe targets Hatterene optimally (Sludge Bomb + Heat Wave), no play saves us—Hatterene faints before TR regardless.

reflections.summary: Leading Mega Charizard Y alongside Chlorophyll Venusaur provided immediate Sun boosted offense and Chlorophyll speed control, allowing us to deny Trick Room and cleanly sweep through their slow Psychic-type leads and Kingambit.
reflections.adjustment: Against heavy Trick Room builds, continue prioritizing Sun-boosted Chlorophyll speed control to double-target TR setters on Turn 1 before they can establish field control.
reflections.notebook: Opponent runs a slow Trick Room structure featuring Mega Gardevoir, Farigiraf, Hatterene, and Kingambit. Chlorophyll Venusaur paired with Mega Charizard Y successfully outspeeds and denies their Trick Room setup before it can activate.

reflections.summary: The game was lost because the Trick Room mode was dismantled before it could be set. On turn 1, Farigiraf was unexpectedly KO'd by a critical hit Heat Wave before it could use Trick Room, leaving the team without speed control against a faster Sun team. The subsequent turns saw the remaining Pokémon picked off one by one by Venusaur and Charizard under Chlorophyll.
reflections.adjustment: Against this Sun team, lead with a Fake Out user or a more durable Trick Room setter like Hatterene next to a redirector or Protect user to guarantee Trick Room goes up. Alternatively, bring a different mode entirely that doesn't rely on a single, fragile setter against spread damage.

Venusaur outspeeds all (200-264 Chlorophyll). Charizard-Y Drought enables Chlorophyll. Opponent double Wide Guard (Swampert, Garganacl) counters spread; answer with single-target Psychic/Kowtow Cleave. Magic Bounce reflects Yawn/Sleep Powder/Will-O-Wisp. Under TR, Kingambit (63) moves before Venusaur (100-132) and Charizard (132-167). Gardevoir at 128 may or may not outspeed Venusaur under TR depending on Venusaur's exact Speed. Opponent tendency: Turn 1 Charizard-Y + Venusaur lead, aggressive Heat Wave + Sludge Bomb targeting the Trick Room setter. Farigiraf is too frail to reliably set TR against this lead without redirection or Fake Out support. Future plan: Lead Hatterene + Indeedee/Amoonguss for safe TR, or use a non-TR mode with speed control (e.g., Tailwind) against this Sun archetype.
